about.tagline: Trusted by millions, built on integrity, driving Dubai's property market since 1960.
about.cornerstone_title: The Cornerstone of Dubai's Real Estate Ecosystem.
about.cornerstone_body: Dubai Land Department regulates and promotes Dubai's real estate sector by providing efficient, transparent, and innovative services that support sustainable development and investor confidence.
about.empower_subtitle: Through seamless services, smart legislation, integrated data, digital infrastructure, and skilled human capital
about.hero_intro: As the custodians of the city's real estate narrative, we, at the Dubai Land and Property Department (DLD), stand at the forefront of innovation, sustainability, and excellence.
about.hero_chip_chairman: Chairman HH Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid
about.story_title: A journey written into Dubai's skyline
about.ch01_body: In the visionary spirit of HH Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum, a pioneer revered for his strategic foresight, Land Registry Department was founded in the 1960s. What started as a humble initiative has evolved into the cornerstone of the Middle East's most vibrant and globally impactful real estate sector empowering it to document and audit certificates while examining and mapping properties.
about.ch02_body1: Nestled under the visionary leadership of HH Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai and Chairman of the Executive Council, the DLD operates as the pulse of Dubai's ever-expanding urban landscape.
about.ch02_body2: Established in January 1960, the Dubai Land Department (DLD) aims to position the real estate sector as a key player on both regional and international fronts. Committed to delivering exceptional services, DLD not only shapes the necessary legislation but also fosters the growth of Dubai's real estate industry. Through the organization and promotion of real estate investment, as well as the dissemination of industry knowledge, DLD actively seeks innovation in the global real estate landscape.
about.ch03_body: At the core of our mission lies an unwavering commitment to delivering unparalleled real estate services. From meticulously documenting property transactions to championing investments, we foster a culture that goes beyond transactions – one that cultivates a well-trained, national cadre and spreads knowledge like seeds in fertile soil. To achieve sustainable development in the sector, DLD channels its efforts toward adopting and adapting international best practices to the unique characteristics of the emirate's property market. This involves effective collaboration among its diverse sectors and agencies.
about.ch03_quote_speaker: HH Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum,
about.ch03_quote_text: a seasoned individual renowned for his expertise and strategic acumen, inaugurated the Land and Property Department on January 23, 1960. This marked the inception of the most significant real estate sector in both the Middle East and the global arena.
about.ch04_body1: DLD is not merely a department; it's a visionary force propelling Dubai's real estate sector into uncharted territories. We aspire to not only meet but exceed the goals set by the Dubai Government, harmonizing our strategies with the latest global practices to create a future where our landscapes are a testament to sustainable development, innovation, and unmatched quality of life.
about.ch04_invite: As you navigate our virtual realm, discover the stories, innovations, and possibilities that define Dubai's ever-evolving skyline. Join us as we script the next chapter of Dubai's real estate legacy!
about.ch04_body2: Operating under the auspices of Dubai's Executive Council, led by HH Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the Dubai Land Department endeavors to provide a spectrum of real estate services including documentation of property transactions, issuance of real estate ownership documents, facilitation of investments, and the dissemination of knowledge to cultivate a well-trained national cadre within the real estate sector.
about.ch04_chip1: Dubai 2040 | Urban Master Plan & Sustainable Development
about.ch05_body1: In 2013, under the directive of HH Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, we were officially entrusted with the responsibility through Law No. (7) 2013. This legal framework guides us in implementing international standards, ensuring a conducive environment for investment and catapulting the sector's growth in our local economy.
about.ch05_body2: DLD is dedicated to realizing the objectives of the Dubai Government's strategy in the real estate sector, with a focus on improving land registration procedures in line with the latest international systems and practices. This commitment aligns with a framework of strategic objectives designed to plan and develop an integrated strategy for enhancing the emirate's real estate industry.

leadership.label: ABOUT DLD
leadership.title: Leadership & Organization
leadership.hero_subtitle: The vision and structure guiding Dubai Land Department.
leadership.messages_subtitle: Insights and strategic vision from our leadership team shaping the future of Dubai's real estate sector.
leadership.chairman_name: HH Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid
leadership.chairman_excerpt: Dubai's real estate market has reached unprecedented heights, powered by visionary leadership and a commitment to transparency. At DLD, we're not just registering transactions — we're building the infrastructure for a world-class property ecosystem.
leadership.chairman_modal_p1: Dubai's real estate market has reached unprecedented heights, powered by visionary leadership and a commitment to transparency. At DLD, we're not just registering transactions — we're building the infrastructure for a world-class property ecosystem.
leadership.chairman_modal_p2: Through RERA, our open data platforms, and digital transformation initiatives, we continue to uphold Dubai's position as the most trusted and investable real estate market in the world. Our AED 761 billion 2024 achievement is a testament to the confidence of investors worldwide.
leadership.chairman_modal_p3: We remain committed to innovation, sustainability, and excellence as we look forward to surpassing these milestones in the years ahead.
leadership.chairman_signature: H.E. Marwan bin Ghalita · Director General, Dubai Land Department
leadership.dg_excerpt: Under the wise guidance of our visionary leadership, Dubai continues to solidify its position as a global hub for investment, innovation, and sustainable development. This momentum is fuelled by an ambitious strategic vision that strengthens competitiveness while advancing the pillars of economic diversification and long-term resilience.
leadership.dg_modal_p1: Under the wise guidance of our visionary leadership, Dubai continues to solidify its position as a global hub for investment, innovation, and sustainable development. This momentum is fuelled by an ambitious strategic vision that strengthens competitiveness while advancing the pillars of economic diversification and long-term resilience. At the heart of this transformation lies the real estate sector, one of the key enablers of economic growth and quality of life in the emirate.
leadership.dg_modal_p2: At Dubai Land Department, we are guided by the vision of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai. Inspired by advanced strategic frameworks, we are implementing a comprehensive roadmap to build a sustainable, resilient, and data-driven real estate sector that acts as a catalyst for other sectors and enhances Dubai's global competitiveness.
leadership.dg_modal_p3: We operate with a spirit of collaboration and institutional integration to empower the real estate sector in fulfilling its critical role in driving economic progress. This includes delivering proactive, customer-centric services, developing forward-looking legislation, and establishing a robust digital infrastructure, all supported by a skilled national workforce. We are equally committed to harnessing real estate data and emerging technologies to elevate transparency, optimise decision-making, and enable all stakeholders to thrive within a knowledge-based ecosystem.
leadership.dg_modal_p4: Our unwavering commitment to the Dubai Real Estate Strategy 2033 remains central to our vision. This includes increasing the sector's added value, promoting homeownership, improving construction quality, and advancing urban sustainability and community well-being. To accelerate these outcomes, we are expanding partnerships across both the public and private sectors—unlocking new opportunities and attracting high-quality investments from strategic global markets.
leadership.dg_modal_p5: Aligned with the Dubai Economic Agenda D33, which aims to double the size of the emirate's economy and position it among the world's top three economic cities, we believe that the real estate sector is one of the most powerful enablers of these national ambitions—given its direct and far-reaching influence on multiple sectors of the economy.
leadership.dg_modal_p6: As we enter a new era of transformative growth, we are confident that the trust of investors, residents, and strategic partners will remain the cornerstone of our success. With confidence, collaboration, and clarity of vision, Dubai will continue to lead with purpose, shaping a future of sustainable prosperity for generations to come.
leadership.dg_signature: His Excellency Omar Bu Shehab, Director General of Dubai Land Department

achievements.hero_subtitle: A legacy of innovation, recognition, and global leadership in real estate
achievements.hero_glass: A decade of firsts, records and global recognition
achievements.world_first_title: First Government Entity to Adopt Blockchain
achievements.world_first_body: First government entity worldwide to adopt blockchain technology for real estate transactions.
achievements.y2014_award1: Idea of the Year — Ejari & DREI
achievements.y2015_headline: A global stage for sustainable cities
achievements.y2016_headline: Host of the 20th World Land Registration Congress
achievements.y2017_headline: First government entity worldwide to adopt blockchain
achievements.y2017_body: In October 2017, following the October 2016 launch of the Dubai Blockchain Strategy by HH Sheikh Hamdan Bin Mohammad bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of Dubai Future Foundation, led by Smart Dubai, DLD achieved another technical milestone by becoming the world's first government entity to adopt blockchain technology.
achievements.cert_headline: A Gulf first, certified twelve times over
achievements.hero_body: The efforts deployed by DLD are not limited and are in line with the desire to achieve excellence in all its sectors and operations. This is reflected in the continuous upgrading of its application standards and in keeping up with the latest global developments in the real estate sector.
achievements.y2014_body: In 2014, DLD won an award during the 'Idea of the Year Competition' for the Ejari programme and for DREI. DLD also received a silver award from The International Stevies for 'Best New Product or Service of the Year' and a Guinness World Record for the largest sticky notes mosaic.
achievements.y2015_body1: In December 2015, under the patronage of HH Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, DLD launched, in partnership with the United Nations Environmental Program (UNEP), the Dubai Sustainable Cities Summit (DSCS). The summit is a leading global event, which was launched to discuss sustainability in the urban environment and the future of smart cities, in the presence of 30 international speakers and 500 dignitaries, government leaders, business executives, and industry professionals.
achievements.y2015_body2: Two additional prestigious awards were won in 2015 from Ideas Arabia in the 'Idea of the Year' category for customer happiness for the Tanmia initiative, and the 'Productivity' category for Registration Trustees.
achievements.y2016_body: In 2016, Dubai hosted the 20th World Land Registration Congress, organised by IPRA-CINDER and DLD. Dubai received the honour based on three criteria: transparency, investor confidence, and legal protection of investor rights.
achievements.y2018_body1: In 2018, under the patronage of HH Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Dubai hosted the 69th FIABCI World Congress — the first time in MENA — under the theme 'Happy Cities.'
achievements.y2018_body2: DLD received many recognitions, most prominently the 'Ideas Arabia 2018' award in the technology category, a key enabler of HH Sheikh Mohammed's vision to enhance creativity and innovation.
achievements.y2018_body3: DLD won three awards in the Dubai Government Excellence Program (DGEP): Distinguished New Employee, Dubai Excellence Medal for best supervisory employee, and Dubai Excellence Medal for best service centre director.
achievements.sustained_body: DLD won the silver category from Investors in People and collected accolades including the Hamdan bin Mohammed Award, two DGEP awards for 'Innovative Leader' and 'Creative Idea', and two e-Government Excellence Awards for advanced customer and social media services.
achievements.sustained_quote: DLD received the Dubai Award for Excellence under Best Government Department and first place in Customer Satisfaction for four consecutive years, along with Employee Satisfaction for team dedication.
achievements.y2021_body1: In 2021, DLD through RERA won silver at the Stevie Awards for its Mollak system, recognised for technical innovation in customer service.
achievements.y2021_body2: DLD also won Gold in Innovation in Government Services at the 2022 MENA Stevie Awards for its smart valuation initiative.
achievements.global_idx_subtitle: DLD also achieved top rankings in the following indexes and reports:
achievements.global_idx_stat1_body: First in the region in real estate transparency index for 2018.
achievements.global_idx_stat2_body: 7th globally and 1st regionally in real estate registration per the World Bank Doing Business Index 2019.
achievements.cert_body: DLD is the first department in the Gulf region to become a member of many worldwide organisations, having added several key achievements, including:

partnerships.title: Partnership & International Relations
partnerships.hero_subtitle: Building strategic partnerships that strengthen collaboration and drive the future of Dubai's real estate sector.
partnerships.commitment_body: Dubai Land Department works through the directives of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, as he said: "Providing excellent services to customers mean building genuine partnerships with them. As it is one of the objectives of which we are keen to achieve and excel in. The government is committed to its customers by providing fast and excellent services, and we will not be satisfied with what has been achieved so far in the field of customer service, but we will provide even better services and faster than now". Consistent with the vision of the department: (To be the global leading real estate environment to attract investments), Partnerships has been a successful field in DLD at its local and regional levels and exceeded the limits to international real estate leading organization. With the Dubai Land Department interface, you will be able to identify our partners, and easily communication with us through applying the forms online for a partnership or communication with the department.
partnerships.contact_subtitle: We are pleased to communicate with any departments particularly through our email address : partnership@dubailand.gov.ae
partnerships.partners_govt_subtitle: This category includes partners in the government and private sector in the United Arab Emirates. These are mostly strategic partners, as they are working with DLD with a plan to achieve a goal or to provide services.
partnerships.partners_re_subtitle: Our real estate industry partners who collaborate to develop and promote Dubai's real estate market.
partnerships.partners_intl_subtitle: International organizations and bodies that collaborate with DLD on global real estate standards and best practices.
